_note: Visual schemas for the hybrid stack: broad regions (one visual zone each) with what each includes. A family lists region keys in report order. The grouper places each sentence in a region and names the structure; Jev maps the free-text scan type to a family.

lung_bases.name: Lung bases
lung_bases.includes: visualised lower lungs and pleura, lower chest

liver.name: Liver
liver.includes: liver parenchyma, focal liver lesions, hepatic contour, cirrhosis, hepatic capsule

biliary.name: Gallbladder and bile ducts
biliary.includes: gallbladder, intrahepatic and common bile ducts

spleen.name: Spleen
spleen.includes: spleen size and lesions, splenic injury

adrenals_kidneys.name: Kidneys, ureters and adrenals
adrenals_kidneys.includes: kidneys, renal calculi, hydronephrosis, perinephric space, ureters, vesicoureteric junction, adrenal glands

bowel.name: Stomach and bowel
bowel.includes: oesophagus below the diaphragm, stomach, duodenum, small bowel, colon, appendix, rectum, bowel wall, diverticula

peritoneum.name: Peritoneum and mesentery
peritoneum.includes: free fluid, ascites, free gas, collections and abscesses, omentum, mesentery, peritoneal deposits, pouch of Douglas

nodes_abdo.name: Abdominal and pelvic lymph nodes
nodes_abdo.includes: retroperitoneal, para-aortic, mesenteric, iliac, pelvic sidewall and inguinal lymph nodes

vessels_abdo.name: Vessels
vessels_abdo.includes: aorta, aneurysm and its neck and thrombus, IVC, iliac arteries, renal and mesenteric arteries, portal, splenic and mesenteric veins, varices

pelvic_organs.name: Pelvic organs
pelvic_organs.includes: uterus, endometrium, cervix, ovaries, adnexa, prostate, seminal vesicles

abdo_bones.name: Bones and body wall
abdo_bones.includes: spine, pelvis bones, ribs, abdominal wall, hernias, muscles and subcutaneous tissues

lungs.name: Lungs and airways
lungs.includes: lung parenchyma, nodules, masses, consolidation, infarcts, contusion, emphysema, scarring, trachea and bronchi

pleura.name: Pleura
pleura.includes: pleural effusion, pneumothorax, haemothorax, pleural thickening

mediastinum.name: Mediastinum
mediastinum.includes: mediastinal masses and fat, thymus, oesophagus, mediastinal haematoma

nodes_chest.name: Thoracic lymph nodes
nodes_chest.includes: mediastinal, hilar, paratracheal, subcarinal, axillary and supraclavicular lymph nodes

heart.name: Heart and pericardium
heart.includes: heart size, cardiac chambers, right heart strain, pericardial effusion, contrast reflux

pulm_arteries.name: Pulmonary arteries
pulm_arteries.includes: pulmonary trunk and arteries, filling defects, emboli, opacification

chest_wall.name: Chest wall and bones
chest_wall.includes: ribs, sternum, thoracic spine, shoulder girdle, breasts, chest wall soft tissues

upper_abdomen.name: Upper abdomen
upper_abdomen.includes: visualised liver, spleen, adrenals, kidneys and upper abdominal organs

brain.name: Brain parenchyma
brain.includes: cerebral hemispheres, grey and white matter, intra-axial masses, oedema, infarcts, enhancing lesions, diffusion

extra_axial.name: Extra-axial spaces
extra_axial.includes: subdural, extradural and subarachnoid spaces and haemorrhage, meninges

csf.name: Ventricles and mass effect
csf.includes: ventricles, sulci, basal cisterns, hydrocephalus, midline shift, effacement, herniation

orbits_sinuses.name: Orbits, sinuses and mastoids
orbits_sinuses.includes: orbits, paranasal sinuses, mastoid air cells, middle ears

scalp.name: Scalp and soft tissues
scalp.includes: scalp, extracranial soft tissues, scalp haematoma

oropharynx.name: Oral cavity and oropharynx
oropharynx.includes: tongue, floor of mouth, palatine tonsils, glossotonsillar sulcus, soft palate, tongue base

larynx.name: Larynx and hypopharynx
larynx.includes: larynx, vocal cords, hypopharynx, piriform sinuses

nodes_neck.name: Lymph nodes
nodes_neck.includes: cervical lymph nodes, levels I to VI, contralateral nodes

neck_soft.name: Deep spaces and soft tissues
neck_soft.includes: parapharyngeal and other deep neck spaces, muscles, subcutaneous tissues

spine_alignment.name: Alignment and vertebrae
spine_alignment.includes: alignment, lordosis, vertebral body heights, marrow signal, fractures

cord.name: Cord and conus
cord.includes: spinal cord calibre and signal, conus, cauda equina

paraspinal.name: Paraspinal and other soft tissues
paraspinal.includes: paraspinal muscles, prevertebral soft tissues, incidental findings outside the spine such as thyroid or kidneys

menisci.name: Menisci
menisci.includes: medial and lateral menisci, meniscal tears

collaterals.name: Collateral ligaments and corners
collaterals.includes: medial and lateral collateral ligaments, posterolateral and posteromedial corners

cartilage.name: Articular cartilage
cartilage.includes: articular cartilage of all compartments, chondral defects

knee_bones.name: Bones and marrow
knee_bones.includes: bone bruising and its pattern, fractures, marrow lesions of femur, tibia and fibula

cuff.name: Rotator cuff
cuff.includes: supraspinatus, infraspinatus, subscapularis and teres minor tendons and muscles, tear size and retraction, fatty atrophy

biceps.name: Biceps
biceps.includes: long head of biceps tendon, bicipital groove

ac_joint.name: Acromion and AC joint
ac_joint.includes: acromion shape, acromioclavicular joint, subacromial bursa

rectum.name: Rectum and mesorectum
rectum.includes: rectal tumour, height from anal verge, muscularis propria, mesorectum, mesorectal fascia, extramural venous invasion, anal canal

nodes_pelvis.name: Lymph nodes
nodes_pelvis.includes: mesorectal, pelvic sidewall, iliac and inguinal lymph nodes

pelvic_fluid.name: Peritoneum and pelvic fluid
pelvic_fluid.includes: free fluid, pouch of Douglas, peritoneal reflection, collections

pelvis_bones.name: Bones and soft tissues
pelvis_bones.includes: pelvic bones, sacrum, hips, pelvic muscles

head_face.name: Head and face
head_face.includes: brain, intracranial haemorrhage, skull, facial bones

limbs.name: Limbs
limbs.includes: upper and lower limb bones and joints

other.name: Other findings
other.includes: a specific structure that fits no region above

abdomen_pelvis.description: CT or MRI of the abdomen and/or pelvis as a whole, including CT KUB, liver MRI and abdominal aortic imaging

chest.description: CT of the chest alone, including CT pulmonary angiogram

chest_abdomen_pelvis.description: CT of the chest, abdomen and pelvis together (staging or follow-up)

head.description: CT or MRI of the head or brain

neck.description: CT or MRI of the neck soft tissues

cervical_spine.description: MRI or CT of the cervical spine

lumbar_spine.description: MRI or CT of the lumbar spine

pelvis_mr.description: MRI of the pelvis alone: gynaecological, prostate or rectal

level_includes: disc, spinal canal, lateral recesses, neural foramina, nerve roots, facet and uncovertebral joints, endplates at this level
